description: Whole-object depth-band PNG integration audit. All detector parameters frozen; renderer/evaluation metadata never enters matching.

protocol.caseDefinition: Every member bbox center at its BAND anchor -6,0,+6; plus 25 points on [64,160,256,352,448] squared. Reject out-of-bounds rectangles.
protocol.primaryOutcome: At least one accepted refined point within tolerance; NOT a sampled outcome.
protocol.secondaryMeasurement: One seeded Born draw per nonempty oracle using the exact ideal Grover first-peak marked/unmarked formula; empty oracle abstains. Secondary illustrations, not an accuracy estimate.
protocol.scope: Controlled same-art fixed-size native PNG audit, not held-out identities, arbitrary photographs, browser raster equivalence, semantic segmentation or speedup evidence.

samplingPolicy: Each scene resets the same declared seeded stream; append and one-shot multi-scene runs agree.
